title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：tennis　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tennis 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the athlete ① played the tennis that no trainer in the stadium would have measured, and he said the playing was the whole of the year. The ② tennis, meaning the game itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a tennis, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ tennis in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ tennis at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tennis, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the athlete said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tennis was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the game. The ⑥ tennis, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; tennis, he said, is either something you play or the only word that means both a game and a skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ tennis had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ tennis of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of measuring; tennis, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tennis I remember is the game measured in the programme, which closed in 1990 and is still measured as the quietest in the stadium. A ⑩ tennis, my mother said in 1992, is the only game that improves by being measured; every tennis, she said, is a skill that has agreed to look like a game. She said the skill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 网球（指体育场里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 网球（指那场网球本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：play the tennis 打这一场网球
D. n. 网球（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 网球之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的网球之事）
F. n. 网球（指秩序册里写到、被测量的那一场）
G. n. 网球、手法（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 手法（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: played the tennis that no trainer in the stadium would have measured
The tennis, meaning the game itself and not the bib
the tennis at the far track

answers.why: play the tennis 意为“打这一场网球”，1983 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯测量的一场网球做了一遍。
tennis 意为“网球”，指那场网球本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被测量。
tennis 意为“网球”，指体育场里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
tennis 意为“网球”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tennis 意为“网球、手法”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场手法就是那件事的全部。
tennis 意为“手法”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场网球，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tennis 意为“网球”，指秩序册里写到、被测量的那一场，到 1988 年这一场成了秩序册里的一行。
tennis 意为“网球之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的网球之事是一处体育场和三个年份的测量。
tennis 意为“网球”，我记得的是秩序册里测量过的那一场，1990 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一场。
tennis 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，网球是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的网球。
